Description: Posted AP payment reversal/void accounting is not implemented.
Posted AR receipt/customer payment void/reversal accounting is not implemented.
Cash/bank transaction reversal/void posting remains deferred.
Sales credit-note reversal/adjustment posting is not implemented.
Compatibility CustomerPayment.IsCreditNote path remains weaker than the primary Sales CreditNote workflow.
Role grants remain global rather than tenant-specific; data access is tenant-scoped by TenantId.
Cross-currency cash/bank transfers and cross-currency reconciliation handling remain unsupported or incomplete.
AP/AR cross-currency settlement is not fully supported when payment/receipt currency differs from allocated invoice currency.
Fixed asset capitalization from procurement receipt/GRV accrual clearing is deferred and guarded.
Fixed asset capitalization reversal/correction accounting is not implemented.
Only straight-line depreciation is supported; other depreciation methods are rejected.
Depreciation run reversal/correction accounting is not implemented.
Period close does not yet enforce fixed-asset depreciation completeness for every active depreciable asset.
Impairment reversal accounting is not implemented; unsupported reversal attempts are rejected.
Posted revaluation/impairment reversal supersession and correction accounting is not implemented.
GL-impacting fixed asset reclassification transfers between accounts/dimensions are not implemented.
Final or partial-period depreciation through disposal date is not automatically calculated.
Fixed asset sale disposal does not create AR invoices cash/bank receipts VAT documents or statutory sale tax outputs.
Revaluation surplus transfer within equity on disposal is not implemented.
Partial/component disposal is not supported; only whole-asset disposal/write-off is supported.
Foreign-currency disposal proceeds are rejected.
Unapplied AP payments AR receipts customer advances and supplier advances are not yet presented as a dedicated aging/statement balance class.
Rich formatted PDF/Excel finance report packs are not implemented beyond backend CSV export foundation.
Portal-specific Ghana statutory filing pack formats and full WHT/VAT withholding certificate workflow are not implemented beyond backend reference tracking and CSV reports.
AP AR and fixed-asset subledger opening balances are not yet migrated as posted source documents/read-model facts; GL opening balances alone cannot support source-level aging/register sign-off.
